---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. "When [...], I have to [...]."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen. If it touches the public API or the CLI, a short sketch of the
types / signatures / flags helps.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other approaches or workarounds you tried.

**Scope check**
- [ ] Keeps the crate lean (minimal deps, pure-Rust where practical).
- [ ] Not already listed under "Scope" in the README (build-id / debuginfod lookup and
      non-x86_64 architectures are known post-v0.1 items).

**Additional context**
References, prior art, or links.
